_help: Linux/macOS counterpart of ico-preview.windows.json, using netpng's ico2png (github.com/tsnomura/netpng — cargo build or its install.sh; needs ico2png on PATH). Extracts the largest size in the icon as PNG, including the PNG-compressed 256px entries that index-based extractors (icotool -i 0) can't be trusted to pick. ico2png takes the input as a positional argument and writes the PNG to stdout, so a small sh -c redirects it into %OUTPUT%. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
_help_args: %INPUT%/%OUTPUT% are passed as $1/$2 (separate argv entries after the "sh" placeholder for $0), not interpolated into the script string, so paths with spaces or quotes are safe.
